scene.note: Your queries cross up to three tables and count or total what they find, without counting anything twice or losing anyone.

steps.note: Each visit leads to the animal that came in.
Each animal leads on to its owner, where the phone number is.
Only this month's visits are kept, each with its animal and its owner on one row.

value.label: the shape of what comes back

steps.note: Winnie has a call to make for every visit.
Every owner is kept, with a row for each animal, or one empty row when there is none.
Each owner is one group, told apart by what is different for every owner, not by the name.
The count skips the empty rows, so an owner with no animal gets nothing counted.

value.label: the shape of what comes back

steps.note: Rosamund has every owner for the yearly review.
Each animal that came in is joined to its visits.
Each visit is joined to its treatments, so a visit with three treatments fills three rows, and a free visit keeps one empty row.
Each animal is one group. Its visits are counted once each, and the prices are added up.

value.label: the shape of what comes back

steps.note: Ifan sees how often each animal came in and what it came to.
Every owner is kept, and only their dogs count as partners.
An owner with no dog still has a row, because the test for dogs only chose the partners.

value.label: the shape of what comes back

steps.note: The supplier gets a count for every owner.
